items.text: Bears planning to start QB Caleb Williams vs Falcons after full week practice no setbacks (missed 3 games hamstring); listed Q but starter reps taken.
items.why: Full participation Thu/Fri, no issues, coach on track; took starter reps.
items.implication: QB upgrade for CHI pass-catchers (Odunze/Burden/Loveland); solid matchup vs ATL.
items.opportunity: Full dropback volume return; elevates WR/TE usage.

items.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown from IR; expected to play Sunday vs Jets after limited practice week post high-ankle sprain.
items.why: Returned to practice, activated to 53; sources confirm play expectation.
items.implication: Immediate WR2/flex upgrade in NE offense vs Jets; monitor snaps post-IR.
items.opportunity: Primary target role return; boosts NE passing volume.

items.text: Eagles placed QB Jalen Hurts on IR due to blood clot in calf after doctor consultations; out indefinitely (min ~6 weeks possible on thinners). Tanner McKee starts.
items.why: Blood clot movement confirmed; medical consensus for IR rest/treatment.
items.implication: McKee starts ROS short-term; Eagles skill players face QB downgrade but healthy top pass-catchers available.
items.opportunity: Pass-catcher volume may shift; thin RB room (Barkley/Shipley also out) elevates backups.

items.text: Pick up Tanner McKee everywhere needing QB; will be better than thought (may need reps in offense). Not worried about any Eagles skill players with him under center.
items.why: McKee can play; healthy skill group mitigates QB change.
items.implication: Stream QB option; start DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks confidently.
items.opportunity: PHI pass volume stable-to-up for remaining weapons.

items.text: Unclear on AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder) Qs. Tyler Warren Friday Q add (groin). Caleb/Metcalf/Olave/Dowdle more probable. PIT thin at WR (Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek out) so Metcalf heavy 2-WR sets. PHI McKee + healthy top-4 pass-catchers (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) despite 4th-string RB.
items.implication: Probables safer starts; unclear Qs risky; PIT Metcalf monopoly; PHI pass-catchers viable under McKee.
items.opportunity: Metcalf target share spike; Warren monitoring; Henderson ankle doubt limits NE RB.
items.conflict: If AJB/Henderson unexpectedly limited, reverse prior beneficiary assumptions.

items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT (hamstring) for Week 6 along with Will Shipley; Eagles RB room extremely thin with 4th-string Dameon Pierce likely featured under McKee.
items.why: DNP week, final report OUT; hamstring not ready.
items.implication: Zero RB production from PHI; handcuff/backup elevation critical; pass-game lean heavier.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/early-down work to Pierce or committee; boosts TE/WR targets.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT for Week 6 (ankle/hamstring related); Tyler Huntley expected to start for Ravens.
items.why: Final injury report confirmation; multiple weeks missed.
items.implication: Ravens offense downgrade; Flowers/Andrews/Henry usage changes under Huntley.
items.opportunity: More checkdowns possible; Henry still workhorse but pass game less explosive.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) Week 6 along with AD Mitchell; Jets RB depth tested vs Patriots.
items.implication: Backup RB elevation (handcuff value); Jets offense limited.
items.opportunity: Committee or lead backup carries/routes spike.

items.text: David Montgomery OUT (groin) for Texans Week 6; impacts HOU backfield vs JAX London.
items.implication: Increased role for other HOU RBs; pass-catching upside elsewhere.

items.text: Rashee Rice OUT (hamstring) Week 6 for Chiefs; Tyquan Thornton also out.
items.implication: Worthy/others elevated targets in KC; Mahomes volume redistribution.
items.opportunity: Xavier Worthy and TE targets rise.

items.text: IN/expected: Ladd McConkey, Quentin Johnston, DeVonta Smith, CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty, Michael Penix, Marvin Harrison Jr. Qs include Ja'Kobi Lane (later activated expected). Multiple OUT confirmed as listed.
items.why: Friday comprehensive report; later activations (Lane/AJB) align.
items.implication: Safe starts for cleared; monitor remaining Qs for GTD.
items.opportunity: Full roles for INs; beneficiaries already noted for OUTs.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH (WR4) due to Commanders defense buffet for pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: High target/redzone upside vs leaky secondary.

items.text: Loves Drake London vs CHI (usage bankable) and Kyren Williams vs ARI (elite recent usage + leaky run D). Also Javonte Williams @GB (goal-line role) and Rhamondre vs NYJ (volume + soft run D).
items.why: Volume + matchup edges; Kyren elite usage, Javonte GL work.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry/target shares in favorable spots.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (tough matchup), Emeka Egbuka vs PIT, Kyle Pitts vs CHI (shaky QB/feed issues). Also hates J.K. Dobbins vs SEA, Bo Nix vs SEA, Justin Herbert @KC.
items.implication: Sit/fade in favor of better options.
items.opportunity: Low expected targets/carries vs elite Ds or poor offense.
